function.name: set_sleep_tracking
function.description: Turn sleep tracking on or off with a bedtime.

bedtime_ref.description: Opaque handle for bedtime, returned by `resolve_set_sleep_tracking__bedtime`. Do NOT pass the raw bedtime value.

function.name: resolve_navigate_to__destination
function.description: Look up the destination for `navigate_to` by name/description and return an opaque handle. Call this FIRST, then pass the returned handle to `navigate_to`.

query.description: The destination as mentioned by the user.

function.name: resolve_add_waypoint__place
function.description: Look up the place for `add_waypoint` by name/description and return an opaque handle. Call this FIRST, then pass the returned handle to `add_waypoint`.

query.description: The place as mentioned by the user.

function.name: resolve_share_eta__contact
function.description: Look up the contact for `share_eta` by name/description and return an opaque handle. Call this FIRST, then pass the returned handle to `share_eta`.

query.description: The contact as mentioned by the user.

function.name: resolve_remove_waypoint__place
function.description: Look up the place for `remove_waypoint` by name/description and return an opaque handle. Call this FIRST, then pass the returned handle to `remove_waypoint`.

query.description: The place as mentioned by the user.

function.name: navigate_to
function.description: Start navigation to a destination with a route preference and departure.

destination_ref.description: Opaque handle for destination, returned by `resolve_navigate_to__destination`. Do NOT pass the raw destination value.

function.name: add_waypoint
function.description: Add a stop along the route at a position for a planned duration.

place_ref.description: Opaque handle for place, returned by `resolve_add_waypoint__place`. Do NOT pass the raw place value.

function.name: share_eta
function.description: Share your ETA with a contact at an interval.

contact_ref.description: Opaque handle for contact, returned by `resolve_share_eta__contact`. Do NOT pass the raw contact value.

function.name: remove_waypoint
function.description: Remove a waypoint from the route.

place_ref.description: Opaque handle for place, returned by `resolve_remove_waypoint__place`. Do NOT pass the raw place value.

function.name: find_poi
function.description: Find a category of place, sorted and optionally open now.

function.name: avoid_route
function.description: Toggle a routing avoidance option for a scope.

function.name: set_speed_alert
function.description: Set a speed warning threshold and tolerance.

function.name: set_map_view
function.description: Set the map display mode and zoom.

function.name: set_traffic_layer
function.description: Turn the live traffic layer on or off with a reroute policy.

function.name: set_voice_guidance
function.description: Set voice guidance verbosity, language and volume.

function.name: set_units
function.description: Set distance and temperature units.

function.name: set_lane_guidance
function.description: Set lane guidance detail and junction view.

function.name: set_alternate_routes
function.description: Set how many alternate routes to show and whether to preview them.
